clauses.quote: employees in such new title or category shall be included within the WTU bargaining unit
clauses.subject_text: employees in such new title or category

clauses.quote: upon request of the WTU the parties shall negotiate the terms and conditions of employment for such new title or category of employees
DCPS shall not, during the life of this Agreement, change the duties and/or responsibilities of an existing job classification without first bargaining to agreement with the WTU
the Chancellor shall notify the WTU President in writing regarding such changes
DCPS agrees to process such forms to the District of Columbia Government for the deduction of the regular WTU dues of such employees from their bi-weekly pay

Arrangements for dues deduction and the revocation of such dues deduction shall be made in accordance with the procedures of the Office of Financial Management Pay and Retirement, District of Columbia Government
clauses.subject_text: Arrangements for dues deduction and the revocation of such dues deduction

clauses.quote: The WTU shall be the only teacher organization eligible to use payroll deduction for membership dues
Teachers have the right to join any teacher organization
membership in a teacher organization shall not be required as a condition of employment
clauses.notes: Negated obligation functioning as a right/relief from duty.
